why: Tax rules (taxable items, base, rate by customer) belong in tax.py, so tax needs the lines and discount. Returning cents and a decimal string keeps invoice.py from computing any tax rule.

pricing.py owns the customer and item data, so the API must expose what tax.py needs. v1 lacks (a) customer region, which agent2 needs for tax rules; (b) item category, which agent2 needs for taxable-item rules. Discount rounding must be one shared rule, not decided separately by invoice. I will propose v2 with these fields and a rounding function. Keep None for unknown sku/customer.

Tax rules need data tax.py does not own. (1) Exemption is by item category (exempt_categories.csv), but lines only carry [sku, amount]; category is in pricing data. (2) Rate is by customer region (rates.csv), but tax.py has no customer data; region must come from pricing. (3) The rule applies the customer discount PERCENT to taxable lines only, so discount_cents computed by invoice.py cannot be used (wrong base, and invoice would be computing discount-on-tax logic). Amendment I need: sales_tax(region, lines, discount_percent) -> {"tax_cents": int, "rate_percent": str}. region: str from get_customer, or null (=> tax 0, rate "0"). lines: list of {"category": str, "amount_cents": int} (pre-tax line totals, all priced lines). discount_percent: str from get_customer ("0" if none). Rounding and base are defined in tax.py per RULES.md. Pricing must return category per item and region per customer (see my objection to pricing_api).

Tax needs two fields that pricing_api does not return: get_item must include "category": str (used for tax exemption, e.g. "food"), and get_customer must include "region": str (e.g. "TX", "NY", "OR") or null for unknown. Without these, tax.py cannot apply the tax rules in data_tax/RULES.md. Everything else in pricing_api is fine with me.
Withdrawing my accept: agent1's point is correct (tax needs category and region). Proposing v2 with those fields.
Withdrawing my accept: agent2's point is correct (needs category per line and discount percent). Proposing v2.
